title: Hold a collection authority for biodiscovery
what: Take native biological material for biodiscovery from State land or Queensland waters only under a collection authority.

sources.title: Biodiscovery Act 2004 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not, unless authorised by a collection authority, take native biological material for biodiscovery from State land or Queensland waters
